profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Infrastructure Optimization and AI Team at KeyBank
profile.summary:
Husband. Father. Motorcycle rider. Senior Technology Engineer focused on Infrastructure Optimization and AI at KeyBank.

I’ve spent 45+ years in tech doing a bit of everything: typewriter repairs, computer hardware repair, software development (Python, Go, and more obsolete languages than I care to admit), network operations, agile delivery, and enterprise monitoring. Along the way I’ve been an Software Engineer, Enterprise Monitoring Architect, Agile coach, DevOps practitioner, and data geek obsessed with making systems observable, reliable, and cost‑efficient.

I love building practical solutions—from cloud billing anomaly detection and FinOps controls to continuous delivery pipelines and automation. I’m also a long‑time Elasticsearch convert, conference speaker, and vacuum tube guitar amplifier designer and builder.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Infrastructure Optimization and AI Team
positions.description:
The Infrastructure Optimization and AI Team was created to address this opportunity and establish a stronger foundation for data‑driven, predictive, and GenAI‑enabled capabilities across KeyBank's Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) Group.

Purpose of the Infrastructure Optimization and AI Team
The team focus on:
* Reducing operational waste by eliminating repeat work and manual efforts across ETS
* Enabling self‑service access to insights across large data sets through the use of reporting, forecasting, reporting and of course GenAI.
* Improving speed to detect and resolve team member workstation and systems issues
* Predicting and forecasting costs, capacity, utilization, and workloads analysis

First Major Initiative: AskIT
The team’s first major initiative will be AskIT, a GenAI‑powered chatbot designed to quickly resolve common technology questions currently handled by the Technology Service Desk (TSD).
The primary goal of AskIT is to reduce TSD call volume by 50%, improving resolution times while freeing capacity for higher‑value support and engineering work.
